topic: software architecture of entity resolution systems

criteria.label: re2
criteria.question: Are the research objectives clear?
criteria.description: Look for clearly structured research questions or hypotheses and well-articulated research objectives.

criteria.label: ri1
criteria.question: Is the research design appropriate?
criteria.description: The methodology should be appropriate for attaining the research objectives. Reporting biases, limitations, and a discussion of the results supports a higher score.
criteria.scoring: 1 to 10, higher indicates a more appropriate research design

criteria.label: r1
criteria.question: How relevant is the study for research in software architecture?
criteria.description: A description of a system is a starting point. Describing its architecture, architectural concepts, multiple perspectives, or an architecture methodology supports a higher score.
criteria.scoring: 1 to 10, higher values mean that software architecture is covered better
